structured_output.content: The release note only says cert-manager now uses a local fork of the `golang.org/x/crypto/acme` package (#7752). It does not describe any change in behavior, configuration or API, so there is nothing concrete to check against the environment. The environment summary also does not show whether ACME issuers are in use. Only `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests and the `certificates.cert-manager.io` CRD are listed, with no Issuer or ClusterIssuer objects; the values key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` is set but does not show ACME use. To decide, check whether any of your issuers use ACME, and read PR #7752 for any behavior changes in the forked client.
